actions_performed: Implemented `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction locking and an atomic conditional stock decrement.
Added identical successful replay results without a second decrement.
Added insufficient-stock and request-ID conflict rejection.
Verified concurrent competing and duplicate-ID requests.
Verified bounded lock timeout with no partial changes.
Restarted node1 and verified persistence and recovery.
Kept CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 unchanged.

evidence.summary: Shows the complete installed implementation, successful compilation, ownership, and executable permissions.

evidence.requirement: Positive quantities, insufficient-stock rejection, idempotent replay, and preservation of existing reservations

evidence.requirement: Concurrent requests keep stock nonnegative and successful IDs decrement exactly once
